posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
Yesterday France announced tax of €0.055 per GB on internet traffic

Today Germany is considering taxing all AI-generated revenue

You will see European countries keep clawing more and more money from foreign companies as they are slowly running out of money themselves to pay https://t.co/GhGFhRhncU
posts.text_zh:
昨天法国宣布对互联网流量征收每 GB €0.055 的税

今天德国正在考虑对所有 AI 产生的收入征税

你会看到欧洲国家不断从外国公司身上抠越来越多的钱，因为他们自己正慢慢没钱可付了 https://t.co/GhGFhRhncU
posts.quoted_text: JUST IN: German minister proposes a new tax on all economic value created by AI.
posts.quoted_text_zh: 引用：刚刚：德国部长提议对 AI 创造的全部经济价值征收新税。

posts.author: gregisenberg
posts.text:
Strange feeling: finding out an album you love was made with AI music models (Suno, Udio, Lyria) and with no people playing instruments.

I play music. I listened for months and had no idea.

The top 1% of AI music is getting scary good. https://t.co/abc3g3nyl8
posts.text_zh:
奇怪的感觉：发现自己喜欢的一张专辑是用 AI 音乐模型（Suno、Udio、Lyria）做的，没有真人演奏乐器。

我自己也玩音乐。听了好几个月完全没听出来。

AI 音乐顶尖的那 1% 已经好到吓人了。https://t.co/abc3g3nyl8
